mapper.sql: SELECT cp.id, cp.brand_id, cp.base_currency_id, cp.quote_currency_id, cp.rate, cp.rate_type, cp.active, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at, b.code AS brand_code, bc.code AS base_currency_code, qc.code AS quote_currency_code FROM currency_pair cp INNER JOIN brand b ON b.id = cp.brand_id INNER JOIN currency bc ON bc.id = cp.base_currency_id INNER JOIN currency qc ON qc.id = cp.quote_currency_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO currency_pair (brand_id, base_currency_id, quote_currency_id, rate, rate_type, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{brandId}, #{baseCurrencyId}, #{quoteCurrencyId}, #{rate}, #{rateType}, #{active}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE currency_pair SET brand_id = #{brandId}, base_currency_id = #{baseCurrencyId}, quote_currency_id = #{quoteCurrencyId}, rate = #{rate}, rate_type = #{rateType}, active = #{active}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
